enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay.readouts: anti-spike IgG titres (EC50), binding antibody responses

focus reduction neutralization titre ass.readouts: live-virus neutralizing antibody titres against SARS-CoV-2 WA1 and B.1.351

evidence_location.quote: BNT162b2 vaccination also induced a neutralizing antibody response against the B.1.351 variant of concern, albeit at a tenfold-lower magnitude than against the wild-type WA1/2020 (WA1) strain ( Fig. 1c )

intracellular cytokine staining assay.readouts: spike-specific CD4 and CD8 T cell cytokine responses, including IFNγ, TNF and IL-4

evidence_location.quote: Vaccination also stimulated spike-specific T cell responses, which were more readily detectable seven days after the secondary immunization ( Fig. 1d , e ).

bead-based antigen arrays.readouts: IgG autoantibody and anticytokine antibody mean fluorescence intensity

evidence_location.section: Lack of autoantibodies or anticytokine antibodies
evidence_location.quote: Anticytokine antibodies were largely absent or were observed at a low mean fluorescence intensity with no significant changes .

cytometry by time of flight.readouts: immune cell frequencies and intracellular phospho-signaling markers including pSTAT1 and pSTAT3

evidence_location.quote: The frequency of intermediate monocytes (CD14 + CD16 + monocytes) increased significantly two days after the primary vaccination, and was substantially higher two days after the secondary vaccination ( Fig. 2b ).

Olink multiplex proximity extension assa.name_in_paper: Olink multiplex proximity extension assay (PEA) inflammation panel
aliases: plasma protein profiling using multiplex Olink panel
measured plasma cytokines in 31 vaccinated individuals using Olink
Olink multiplex proximity extension assa.readouts: cytokine concentrations including IFNγ, CXCL10, IL-10 and IFNα2

evidence_location.quote: Of the 67 cytokines detected, the concentration of 2 cytokines (IFNγ and CXCL10) were increased significantly on days 1 and 2 after primary vaccination ( Fig. 2e left).

bulk mRNA sequencing.readouts: gene expression, differentially expressed genes, interferon and innate transcriptional modules

evidence_location.quote: Secondary vaccination generated a greater transcriptional response (as has previously been seen in a recent study of adjuvanted hepatitis B vaccine 17 ), with nearly a fourfold increase of differentially expressed genes at day 22 as compared to day 1 ( Fig. 3a )

cellular indexing of transcriptomes and.name_in_paper: cellular indexing of transcriptomes and epitopes by sequencing
cellular indexing of transcriptomes and.readouts: single-cell RNA and surface protein-defined cell clusters, cluster frequencies, cell-type-specific gene expression signatures

evidence_location.quote: Notably, cluster C8 (which expressed CD14 , VCAN , CD1C , FCGR1A and CD274 mRNA or protein) emerged on day 22, one day after secondary vaccination ( Fig. 4b ).

qPCR.readouts: gene expression of induced C8 signature transcripts after IFNγ or plasma stimulation

evidence_location.quote: In vitro stimulation of purified healthy monocytes with IFNγ or day-22 plasma also induced a C8 signature, which suggests that IFNγ has a key role in inducing cluster C8, in response to mRNA vaccination .
